title: Fibonacci with Memoization
description:
Write a function `fib(n)` that returns the nth Fibonacci number using **memoization**.

The Fibonacci sequence: F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2).

Your solution must use memoization (caching) to avoid redundant recursive calls. Simply computing iteratively is also acceptable but memoization is the goal.
hint: Create a dictionary to cache computed values. Before computing fib(n), check if it is already in the cache.
outputExplanation: fib(10) = 55. Memoization stores each computed value, reducing the time complexity from O(2^n) to O(n).
